title: Comparison instruments, review and math grammar, with the token form for keys (I-R2)
question: Do the validator, quote locator, value equivalence, aligner, scores and keys implement D7 §5 and ADR-0009? Do they key every math value by D1 §6.2's token form (ADR-0012), and what moves when they do?
method: Worker-built instruments, independent implementation review (F1–F5 fixed), hand alignment against the trace diff, math-grammar coverage. I-R2 (2026-10-28): mathgrammar.printer realizes D1 §6.2's token form (TeX tokenizer with no * in control words; one declared drop list, SymPy 1.14.0's latex.lark %ignore literals plus the 16 sizing commands, from which build generates the grammar's sizing %ignore and against which it checks every %ignore; text-mode whitespace collapsed to one space; one outer \(…\), \[…\] or math-environment pair removed, not $; macro depth 16), api.canonical and values.canonical_latex return it for every value, and the tree printer is checked against it (api.tree_token_agreement) over every math span of the four spike pages. The key forms of every batch value are compared with the instruments at 35ea59a (code/i_r2_key_diff.py); the nine root manual-decision keys written in the old spelling were rewritten to the token form (code/i_r2_migrate_manual.py; no decision or reason changed). Math-grammar coverage rerun: its S0 value set grew from 86 to 92 because the Sonnet passes' stored sets (pass_sg, pass_sp) were added after the I-R1 coverage run; the pre-I-R2 grammar gives the same 92 values and statuses, so the change is the input set, not I-R2. Runs after the spike venv was checked against its lock (uv sync --locked --check, 2026-10-28 15:42).
commands: cd code/tests_instruments && UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT=$REPO/build/spike-venv uv run --locked python run_all.py --logs

results.name: grammar_values_read
results.note: 86 of 86 at I-R1; the input set grew (pass_sg, pass_sp); the 5 not read are text in math (N \text{ cm} x4, \text{the constant})

results.name: spike_page_spans_tree_token_agree
results.note: parsed spans of 918 on the four spike pages; 4 differed (at \big/) before I-R2

results.name: key_forms_moved
results.note: distinct batch values and symbols; all text-mode whitespace

conclusion: The aligner reproduces the hand classification; keys are now the token form for every value, the tree printer agrees with it on all 881 parsed spike-page spans, and only 5 text-mode-whitespace values change form; with the manual decision keys migrated, every S0 and S0-R2 comparison reproduces its figures.
